MRI Safety Information
Non-clinical testing has demonstrated that the Pylon Neuromodulation System is MR Conditional. A patient with this device can be safely scanned in an MR system meeting the following conditions:
• Static magnetic field of 1.5 Tesla and 3.0 Tesla only
• Maximum spatial field gradient of 12 T/m or less
• Maximum gradient slew rate of 200 T/m/s per axis
• B1+rms ≤ 1 microtesla; if B1+rms is not available, limit whole-body SAR to 1 W/kg
• Scanning in the Normal Operating Mode of operation for the MR system
• Any receive-only coil may be used
• RF excitation: circularly polarized (CP) only
Under the scan conditions defined above, the Pylon Neuromodulation System is expected to produce a maximum temperature rise of less than 3.0 °C after 15 minutes of continuous scanning.
